review.scope: an independent review agent read the first five commits against main; 95bd46c4 fixes every finding
findings: status probe: git() ignored the per-call timeout, so the 20-second limit never applied
a push retried after a refusal merged the remote twice, adding a second copy of each diverging document or space, and reported only the second attempt
an ownerless lock was taken over after one minute (an older Host's slow push); two Hosts could both take one stale lock
an automatic sync failure reason outlived its error; a busy channel counted as a failure
the comparison read the preview and the file diff at once and could meet its own lock
remote-only and local-only counts repeated held-back entries and local removals
a sync started in the comparison, and a failed disconnect, failed behind their dialogs
HTTPS hosts other than github.com were told to sign in with GitHub; a not-found repository offered no credentials shortcut
one failed poll ended the GitHub sign-in; another owner's repository of the same name blocked creating one's own
the history did not say it lists the latest 100 versions
an author an earlier version saved with one field blocked other advanced changes
the token's Remove button sat inside the field's label
guide: an unreachable remote described as committing locally; MNEMON_SYNC_GIT_TOKEN precedence over a GitHub sign-in; unlimited history
